title: Não foi assim
theme: Past simple negativo e perguntas (didn't / Did you...?)
goal: Aluno sai sabendo formar negativas com didn't + base e perguntas com Did + base (regular e irregular).
connects_to: M18 (Planos pra amanhã) — depois do passado completo, vai pro futuro com going to.
module_chunks: I didn't / you didn't / she didn't / they didn't
Did I...? / Did you...? / Did she...? / Did they...?
Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
WH + did + sujeito + verbo base (Where did you go? What did she do?)

units.title: Eu não fiz
units.real_life_context: Você esclarece o que NÃO fez ontem.

grammar.explanation: Past simple negativo: "didn't + verbo base". "Didn't work" = não trabalhei.
"Didn't" pra todas as pessoas no passado. "She didn't go".
"Didn't" + base. Plural ou singular, todos usam didn't.
"He didn't see" — past negativo com didn't + base. Mesmo em 3ª pessoa, didn't (não doesn't).
"I didn't have" — passado negativo. Note: verbo base "have", não "had".
"She didn't call" — didn't + base "call" (não "called").
"They didn't go" — plural também usa didn't.
Após "didn't", verbo SEMPRE base: "go", não "went". "Didn't already carries past — verbo principal volta pra forma base.
"Yesterday" indica passado → "didn't" (não "doesn't" que é presente).

grammar.passage: I didn't work yesterday. I didn't go out either. I didn't see anyone. It was a quiet day.
grammar.question: Did the speaker work?
grammar.explanation: O texto diz "I didn't work yesterday".

listening_speaking.text: She didn't go to the party.

units.title: Você fez?
units.real_life_context: Você pergunta sobre o que alguém fez ontem.

grammar.explanation: Pergunta passado: "Did + sujeito + verbo base?". "Did you go?".
"Did she like?" — past question com Did pra qualquer pessoa.
"Did they win?" — plural também com Did.
"Did you eat?" — past question. Atenção: verbo base "eat", não "ate".
"Did he call?" — past question com Did. Verbo base "call" depois.
"Yes, I did" — short answer pra past question.
"No, she didn't" — short answer negativa.
Após "Did", verbo SEMPRE base: "go", não "went". Did já carrega o passado.

grammar.hint: Saw é passado, pergunta com Did
grammar.explanation: Pra passado usa "Did", não "Do". E após "Did" usa base: "see".

grammar.passage: Q: Did you go to the gym? A: Yes, I did. Q: Did your sister come? A: No, she didn't. She had work.
grammar.question: Did the sister come?
grammar.explanation: The text says "No, she didn't".

listening_speaking.text: Did you go to the party?
Yes, I did. No, I didn't.

units.title: Onde, quando, o quê?
units.grammar_focus: Past WH-questions (Where did you...? What did she...?)
units.real_life_context: Você faz entrevistas curtas — onde, quando, com quem, por quê.

grammar.explanation: WH + did + sujeito + base: "Where did you go?".
"What did she eat?" — past WH question com Did.
"When did they arrive?" — pergunta WH no passado.
"Why did he leave?" — WH no passado + base.
"How did you get here?" — pergunta WH no passado.
"Who did you meet?" — past WH com Did.
"What time did she arrive?" — pergunta horário no passado.
"Did" já carrega o passado. Verbo principal vai pra base: "go", não "went".
WH + DID + sujeito + base. "What did she do?", não "What she did?".

grammar.passage: Q: Where did you go? A: I went to the beach. Q: What did you do? A: I swam and read. Q: When did you come back? A: At seven.
grammar.question: What did the speaker do at the beach?
grammar.explanation: O texto diz "I swam and read".

units.title: Eu nunca fiz isso
units.real_life_context: Você fala sobre o que nunca fez ou não fez.

grammar.explanation: "I never visited" = "Nunca visitei". "Never" sozinho (sem didn't): "I never visited Japan".
Past negativo padrão: "didn't + base". "She didn't come".
"We never knew" = "Nunca soubemos". Sem auxiliar — verbo no passado direto.
"He didn't understand" — past negativo. (Could also be "never understood" but with simple/no auxiliary structure).
"I didn't travel" — padrão. "I never traveled" também funciona (sem didn't).
"She never said" — passado direto sem auxiliar. Equivale a "She didn't say anything".
"They didn't arrive" — passado negativo.
NÃO usa dupla negativa em inglês. Ou "I never went" OU "I didn't go" — não ambos.

grammar.hint: Com "never", o verbo no passado simples
grammar.explanation: "Never" + verbo no PASSADO (came), não na base. Diferente de "didn't + base".

grammar.passage: I never visited Japan, but I went to China. My sister didn't travel last year. She stayed home.
grammar.question: Where did the sister stay?
grammar.explanation: O texto diz "She stayed home".

listening_speaking.text: She didn't come to the party.

grammar.explanation: Past simple afirmativo irregular: "went".
Passado negativo: didn't + base.
Past question com Did.
WH no passado + Did.

"Why did he leave?" — pergunta WH no passado.
didn't + base, não "didn't went".
Did + sujeito + base. "See", não "saw".
